notes: No network source acquisition is permitted; GitHub and all other external platforms are optional provenance/mirror surfaces only.

Resolve source only from an already-local verified root, including the four canonical STEGVERSE_*_SOURCE_ROOT locators admitted through this adapter, or a content-addressed StegVerse source package in the local package store.

Historical Git blob anchors are provenance markers, not immutable hashes of current source bytes; current integrity is the complete sha256-content-manifest identity plus required runtime marker presence.
Stops HANDOFF_READY when a required package/root is absent; no automatic platform fallback exists.
No credential, repository writeback, SDK admission, governance, publication or certification authority.
